# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 26 Nov 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## HDB Resale & Records

- **Clementi 4-room flat sets new area record at $1.38M** - A 1,001 sq ft four-room flat at Block 445B Clementi Avenue 3 sold for $1.38 million ($1,379 psf) in November 2026, the highest price ever recorded for a four-room resale flat in Clementi. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/clementi-crest-4-room-flat-sets-1-38m-record-at-1379-psf/)

- **Queenstown has the smallest price gap for HDB upgraders moving to resale condos** - A 1,000–1,399 sq ft resale condo in Queenstown had a median price of $2.2M against $1.26M for a 5-room or executive HDB flat there — the smallest percentage upgrade gap across all 24 HDB towns. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/queenstown-upgraders-resale-condo-costs-940k/)

- **Jurong West 4-room flats top the HDB rental yield table at nearly 8%** - Jurong West 4-room flats recorded the highest gross rental yield among all HDB towns at close to 8%, compared with over 6% islandwide. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/hdb-town-singapores-highest-rental-yield/)

## Private Market Pricing

- **New Serangoon condo three-bedder now costs more than a larger Marina Bay unit** - A new three-bedder at Chuan Park in Serangoon had a median sale price of $3.3M, above the $2.9M median for a larger unit at Marina Bay Suites, where all nine repeat sales recorded a loss. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/chuan-parks-new-3-bedders-at-s3-28m-cost-more-than-marina-bay-suites-s2-9m-resales/)

## Buyer Sentiment & Affordability

- **Two-thirds of Gen Z and Millennials plan to buy, but cite affordability and ABSD as obstacles** - ERA's 2026 Dream Home Survey found 66% of Gen Z and Millennial respondents intend to purchase a home and prefer larger spaces, with affordability, ABSD and property taxes listed as the main barriers. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/two-thirds-plan-to-buy-a-home-but-the-dream-home-has-to-fit-the-budget/)
